entities.name: Nitroalkane reduction to aminomethyl
observations: Reactant decodes as O=[N+]([O-])CC12CCCN1CCC2 and product as NCC12CCCN1CCC2.
The carbon-bound nitro group –CH2NO2 is reduced to a primary aminomethyl group –CH2NH2; the bicyclic tertiary amine is retained.
Four matching ORD records reported the same substrate/product pair.

entities.name: Fe HCl ethanol
observations: An ORD record directly lists Fe, HCl, and ethanol for this nitro-to-amine transformation.
This is the clearest directly documented reagent system among the matching records.

entities.name: Catalytic hydrogenation
observations: H2 with Pd/C, Ni, or Pt is chemically plausible for reducing a carbon-bound nitro group to a primary amine, but these systems were not directly documented in the retrieved matching records.
